name: How long does a typical flat roof repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flat roof repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flat roof repair depends on the extent of the damage, the size of the area needing repair, and the weather conditions. Small repairs, such as patching a minor leak, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive damage, like replacing sections of the membrane or addressing significant water damage, could take several days. A professional assessment will provide a more accurate timeline for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies based on damage extent and weather. Minor repairs can take hours, while extensive ones may take several days.
